alfred_method: Reuse exact campaign AlfredDownloadForm, alfred_form_body, fetch_alfred via selected AST definitions only. One DFII10 June 2025 sample, GET form then POST all advertised vintages in the declared month; zipped CSV real-time periods. Include observed form[download_data] empty submit field; 60s timeout. This corrects request parity but does not claim the previous timeout was caused by that field.

series.economic_source: Federal Reserve Board H.15, 10-year inflation-indexed Treasury yield

archive_index_truncation_policy: No CDX request repeated. Prior timeouts preserved.
archive_policy: Fetch exactly the two archive snapshots returned by Availability API. Capture date is only a known-by upper bound on publication, and the earliest permitted use under this evidence, plus one complete D1. Verify replay timestamp, original URL and body before admission; never assign either copy to an earlier request date. The COT snapshot is after the documented revision. No coverage claim from isolated snapshots.
availability_rule: Only after schema, vintage periods and publication-date evidence are validated. Use upper bound end of release date in America/New_York and wait one additional complete canonical XAU D1 interval; never backfill a first-created series into earlier decisions.
purpose: Follow up confirmed archived capture metadata with two exact snapshot requests; repair missing public form submit field and retest the same DFII10 sample once. No predictor admission.
transport_role: Mac HTTP relay only; byte-identical canonical probe and owner; no research computation or code edits on relay
